summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.59/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.59 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 28, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ lower than a week ago, 63¢ lower than a month ago, and 66¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.40) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.79).
